contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Radiate of Victorinus (269-271), possibly Cunetio no. 2571 from a weakly struck reverse visible only as a 'shadow', Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate bust bearded cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: IMP C VICTORI[NVS] AVG. Reverse description: possibly Pietas leaning left towards altar left.
